mentl/620fa23:
std/runtime/strings.ka grows a complete sorted-string-set primitive
suite: set_contains (O(log N) bsearch), set_union / set_diff /
set_intersect (O(N+M) two-pointer merges), set_subset / set_disjoint
(O(|a| log |b|)), set_eq (O(N) sorted equality), set_canonicalize
(boundary sort+dedup), set_insert (sorted insert), set_trim (slice
to logical length).

graph.ka, own.ka, effects.ka now route every string-set op through
the shared primitives via thin adapters that canonicalize at the
boundary. The local list_head/list_tail snoc-walk + ++-output-build
pattern is gone:

- graph.ka: list_union_str + string_in_list now delegate to
  set_union / set_contains.
- own.ka: string_in_list delegates to set_contains.
- effects.ka: sort_unique, insert_sorted, list_intersect,
  list_diff_str, list_subset_str, list_disjoint, list_eq_str,
  string_in_list — all delegate.

Inputs that don't yet maintain the sort invariant get canonicalized
at the boundary; once EffRow / record-field builders emit sorted-flat
by construction, the canonicalize calls drop out and the substrate
runs at O(N+M) merge / O(log N) membership end-to-end. Cosmetic for
current set sizes (≤ ~5) but completes the substrate discipline that
the trail (W8) and overlays (W8.1) already follow.

two-top/6239c2a:
Lands the full Phase 9 sim feature set: arena walls with collision
resolution, walk speed tuned to cross the arena in ~2 s, the dash
mechanic with locked-direction impulse + i-frames + cooldown, a
render-side camera follow with exponential damping, and the canonical
demo extended to exercise dash and wall collision in the cross-
platform determinism matrix.

Cycle 1 — walls + arena geometry:
  * fixed_math::RectF — AABB primitive (min/max corners). contains/
    overlaps/translated/from_center_half_extents helpers, all fixed-
    point. Strict-edge overlap (touching != colliding) so the resolver
    doesn't keep nudging at-rest players. 9 unit tests + 2 property
    tests in crates/fixed_math/tests/properties.rs.
  * sim::Wall { kind: WallKind, rect: RectF }, sim::WallKind::Solid.
    Walls are NOT rollback subjects — they don't move, don't change
    kind. They're regular entities the sim queries each tick.
  * sim::PLAYER_HALF_EXTENT_CM = 16 (32 cm square footprint).
    sim::ARENA_HALF_WIDTH_CM = 500, ARENA_HALF_HEIGHT_CM = 750
    (1000 × 1500 cm playable area). WALL_THICKNESS_CM = 50.
  * sim::arena_walls() returns the 4 boundary walls in fixed spawn
    order — determinism depends on the order being identical across
    hosts (entity ids end up bit-identical iff the spawn sequence is).
    Layout: north and south walls span full inner width; west and
    east walls cover full corner-to-corner height (so corners get
    exactly one wall covering them).
  * crates/app/src/lib.rs spawns the walls in setup() with grey
    sprites for visualization; spawn order matches arena_walls().
  * 6 sim wall-geometry tests in crates/sim/tests/walls.rs (closed
    boundary, default spawn positions clear, walls are pairwise
    disjoint, etc).

Cycle 2 — wall_collision system:
  * sim::resolve_collision(player, wall) — pure helper, returns the
    minimum-translation push vector. Picks the smaller-overlap axis
    so the resolver moves the player out the easy way. Uses 2×cente
noodles/624087c:
The master strip becomes a door: tapping the Master meter (or name) opens
a mix bus editor with the chain's own four levers — level into the chain,
juice (the saturator's level-compensated drive), weight (the low shelf),
and glue (how hard the mix leans on the bus compressor). Defaults equal
the compiled constants, so a fresh song is bit-identical to before; edits
apply live and offline through the same applyMasterTo, so exports render
what the room heard, and the state rides project save/load with older
saves falling back to the defaults. The strip also grows from 36px to
50px so the Master label stops clipping mid-word, centered without the
color dot. The per-strip corner-name label above the sound button is
dropped — the sound page itself shows where a patch sits — and the smoke
now walks the master door instead of asserting that label.
